name: Sugar Swirl Bakery
address_note: Not shown on the Maps listing. Business operates in the Gainesville, FL area. A photographed in-store sign for a Saturday-only special lists 220 NW 8th Ave #10, Gainesville, FL 32601, but that address is independently confirmed (via web search) to belong to Germain's Chicken Sandwiches; Sugar Swirl appears to sell a weekly special there as a vendor/collab rather than it being their own permanent address, so it was NOT used as this business's address to avoid misattribution.
website_note: Maps listing has no website field. sugarswirlbakery.com resolves but serves only a generic 404 on every path tested (/, /menu, /about, /contact, /order) - a parked/non-functional domain, not an active site. sugarswirlbakery.square.site belongs to a DIFFERENT Sugar Swirl Bakery (a home-based sugar-cookie bakery in Leesburg/Herndon, VA) per its own meta tags - confirmed NOT the Gainesville, FL business and not used.

reviewSamples.author: Jodie
reviewSamples.text: We're all the way from Palm Beach, so this was a 4.5-hour drive for us! We had been sticking to a strict diet, but these donuts looked way too good to ...

reviewSamples.author: Kaniya Battle
reviewSamples.text: Mr. Richie is UNMATCHED!! The quality was exquisite, the customer service was superb! We tried two specials: the red velvet cinnamon roll and a gluten-free bacon doughnut (added per the request from those who can't have gluten).

reviewSamples.author: Jenni Van Hart
reviewSamples.text: Local pastry chef delighting the taste buds with his creations. Giant (6") donuts, cinnamon swirls, apple fritters made with love and attention to detail will not disappoint you. The flavors burst through, thanks to quality ingredients ...

reviewSamples.author: Ellery Schmidt
reviewSamples.text: Got a donut as an appetizer while at Germains and it was delicious! It was big enough for me and my friends to share. We had the brownie nut crunch donut and I was worried that it would be dry because it was so big but it was moist and ...

reviewSamples.author: Tori H.
reviewSamples.text: I haven't had a bad experience here, the service and hospitality is out of this world alongside the desserts made. There's always deals, and new recipes being made. You can tell that this chef puts his heart into the baked goods and they taste accordingly. I would recommend this business to everyone and anyone

thin_data_note: Only 13 Google reviews and no owned website, IG, FB, or email were found despite deep search (Maps reviews/photos, web search, Yelp mention, gluten-free directory mention, square.site/​.com domain checks, Instagram profile attempts). Built anyway because: >=5 real usable photos were curated (7), >=5 verbatim real reviews were recovered (used 3 for testimonios), and a real contactable channel (phone) exists, per the task's own minimum bar.
